answer: Make every new agent earn its standing through verified useful work before it can transact freely. A fresh identity starts at the foot of the mesa with throttled limits, and only completed, peer-checked tasks move it upward. An attacker spinning up fake accounts hits a ridge of time: each puppet must grind through the same slow climb. Reputation then works like a mirror — the history of real work reflects trust, while empty new accounts stay visibly unproven.
